verdict.rationale: Airwallex supports opening multiple Global Accounts/currency wallets and programmatically creating accounts for customers (docs-17, docs-18, docs-23, docs-25), which covers the 'multiple sub-accounts' part, but there is no evidence of a rules-based auto-allocation engine that splits or routes incoming deposits across those accounts automatically. missing for 10: explicit auto-allocation/rules feature for incoming deposits, documentation of allocation logic or triggers, finance-lead-specific tooling for split deposits.
